name: Jin
source:
A soul tied to a place, unique in kind, his long solitary years drag. So long has it been since anyone could see him he has long since forgotten his own name. 

His words wise, yet his voice rarely heard. 

Outwardly playful, this mysterious individual is hard to read in truth. A truth hidden deep beneath a mask.
